collection.title: Daihatsu Extol 2000 to 2006 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Daihatsu Extol 2000 to 2006 model which requires a 19" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
